newsitem.title: USA: BellSouth to launch payphone subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: BellSouth to launch payphone subsidiary.

text.p: BellSouth Corp said on Tuesday it will create a new subsidiary, BellSouth Public Communications Inc, to focus on payphone services.
The new unit begins life April 1 with more than 172,000 payphones in nine Southeastern states.
BellSouth said a separate unit will be more flexible and more focused on this market segment, which is being deregulated.

BellSouth said it still is waiting for Federal Communications Commission approval on its plan to assure that it will provide non-discriminatory telephone line services to all independent payphone service providers.
The new BellSouth payphone subsidiary is based in Homewood, near Birmingham, and employs more than 785 people in BellSouth's nine-state region.
